sourceRefs.locator: V.1, opening and notes: Brunhild and her children in Paris, Childebert’s removal and Christmas accession in 575, subsequent separation of the family.
IX.20, Copy of the Agreement, preamble and clauses on Paris, Clodechild, Childebert’s children, Faileuba, Chlodosind, Galswinth’s cities, the leudes, travel and oaths.

summary.de: Sohn Sigiberts und Brunichilds. Er wurde 575 als Kind König und verhandelte 587 mit seiner Mutter und seinem Onkel Guntram.
summary.en: Son of Sigibert and Brunhild. He became king as a child in 575 and in 587 negotiated with his mother and his uncle Guntram.
